# Operationalisation of Populism

# Create maximum value from populism dimensions
```{r}
# Spalte mit Max Wert erstellen
df_gesamt$pop_max <- pmax(df_gesamt$Anti_Elitism, df_gesamt$People_Centrism, na.rm = TRUE)

min(df_gesamt$pop_max, na.rm = TRUE)
max(df_gesamt$pop_max, na.rm = TRUE)
# es gibt keinen Wert der 0 ist
```


# Create boxplot

```{r}
boxplot(df_gesamt$pop_max,
        main = "Verteilung des maximalen Populismuswerts (pop_max)",
        ylab = "Populismus max",
        col = "skyblue")

boxplot.stats(df_gesamt$pop_max)$stats
# Whisker: 0,038513

whisker <- 0.038513

# Wie viele Werte über Max Whisker
sum(df_gesamt$pop_max > 0.038513, na.rm = TRUE)
mean(df_gesamt$pop_max > 0.038513, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
#### Anzahl der Werte mit pop_max > 0.038513: 12.377
# Prozentualer Anteil: 14,54 
```

## Violin plot with whiskers and percentiles
```{r}
# Perzentile und Whisker berechnen
perc_90 <- quantile(df_gesamt$pop_max, 0.9)
perc_92 <- quantile(df_gesamt$pop_max, 0.92)
perc_95 <- quantile(df_gesamt$pop_max, 0.95)
whisker <- boxplot.stats(df_gesamt$pop_max)$stats[5]
median_val <- median(df_gesamt$pop_max)

# Dataframe für Schwellenlinien (für Legende)
cutoffs <- data.frame(
  Wert = c(whisker, perc_90, perc_92, perc_95, median_val),
  Schwelle = factor(c("Whisker", "90% Perzentil", "92% Perzentil", "95% Perzentil", "Median"),
                    levels = c("Whisker", "90% Perzentil", "92% Perzentil", "95% Perzentil", "Median"))
)

violinplot_schwellenwerte <- ggplot(df_gesamt, aes(x = "", y = pop_max)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "lightblue", color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(data = cutoffs, aes(yintercept = Wert, color = Schwelle, linetype = Schwelle), size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Whisker" = "#B34FDE",
    "90% Perzentil" = "#F59E42",
    "92% Perzentil" = "red",
    "95% Perzentil" = "#33A02C",
    "Median" = "black"
  )) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
    "Whisker" = "dashed",
    "90% Perzentil" = "dashed",
    "92% Perzentil" = "dashed",
    "95% Perzentil" = "dashed",
    "Median" = "solid"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Verteilung des maximalen Populismuswertes",
    subtitle = "Violinplot mit Schwellenwerten, Perzentilen und Median",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Maximaler Populismus-Score pro Satz",
    color = "Schwellenwert",
    linetype = "Schwellenwert"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "violinplot_schwellenwerte.png",  
  plot = violinplot_schwellenwerte,
  width = 8,         
  height = 6,         
    units = "in",        
  dpi = 300              
)
ggsave(
  filename = "violinplot_schwellenwerte_2.png",  
  plot = violinplot_schwellenwerte,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600    # or 1200
)

ggsave(
  filename = "violinplot_schwellenwerte_3.pdf",
  plot = violinplot_schwellenwerte,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  units = "in"
)

# Install ragg (if necessary)
install.packages("ragg")


# Then specify device in ggsave:
ggsave(
  filename = "violinplot_schwellenwerte_ragg.png",
  plot = violinplot_schwellenwerte,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  device = ragg::agg_png
)
```

## Edge cases of the whisker

```{r}
# Grenzfälle des Whiskers
whisker <- 0.038513

# Perzentilrang berechnen (wie viel Prozent sind kleiner/gleich)
perzentil <- ecdf(df_gesamt$pop_max)(whisker) * 100
perzentil
## 85,5 perzentil 

# Top 5 über dem Whisker
top5_ueber_whisker <- df_gesamt %>%
  filter(pop_max > whisker) %>%
  arrange(pop_max) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  mutate(grenztyp = "über")

# Top 5 unter dem Whisker
top5_unter_whisker <- df_gesamt %>%
  filter(pop_max <= whisker) %>%
  arrange(desc(pop_max)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  mutate(grenztyp = "unter")

# Combine into one table

top5_tab_whisker <- bind_rows(top5_ueber_whisker, top5_unter_whisker) %>%
  select(grenztyp, Satz = sentences...20, Populismus = pop_max, Sendung = sendung)

top5_tab_whisker <- bind_rows(top5_ueber_whisker, top5_unter_whisker) %>%
  select(grenztyp, sendung, sentences...20, pop_max)
```

### Table of edge cases whisker

```{r}
last_ueber <- max(which(top5_tab_whisker$grenztyp == "über"))

 top5_tab_whisker_final <- top5_tab_whisker %>%
  mutate(
     Populismus = round(as.numeric(pop_max), 3),
     Grenztyp   = ifelse(grenztyp == "über", "▲ über", "▼ unter"),
     Sendung    = ifelse(sendung == "Haf", "HaF", sendung)
   ) %>%
   select(Grenztyp, sentences...20, Populismus, Sendung) %>%
   gt() %>%
   tab_header(
     title = "Grenzfälle rund um den Whisker",
     subtitle = paste0("Top 5 Sätze über und unter der Grenze (Whisker = ", whisker, 
                       ", ca. ", round(perzentil,1), " Perzentil)")
   ) %>%
   fmt_number(
     columns = "Populismus",
     decimals = 3
   ) %>%
   cols_label(
     Grenztyp   = "Grenztyp",
     sentences...20       = "Satz",
     Populismus = "Populismus-Score",
     Sendung    = "Sendung"
   ) %>%
   tab_style(
     style = cell_borders(
       sides = "bottom",
       color = "#2d2d2d",
       weight = px(4)
     ),
     locations = cells_body(rows = last_ueber)
   ) %>%
   cols_width(
     sentences...20 ~ px(900)
   ) %>%
   tab_options(
     table.font.size = 14,
     heading.align = "left",
     data_row.padding = px(7)
   )


library(webshot2)
# Save as HTML
gtsave(top5_tab_whisker_final, "top5_tab_whisker_final.html")

# Save HTML as PNG 
webshot("top5_tab_whisker_final.html", "top5_tab_whisker_final.png", zoom = 2) 
```

# Percentile analysis
## Content review 90-95th percentile
```{r}
# Perzentil-Schwellen definieren (90% bis 95%)
probs <- seq(0.90, 0.95, by = 0.01)
grenzwerte <- quantile(df_gesamt$pop_max, probs, na.rm = TRUE)

#For-Schleife für Grenzfälle
for(i in seq_along(grenzwerte)) {
  cat("\n--- Percentile:", names(grenzwerte)[i], 
      "(Threshold:", grenzwerte[i], ") ---\n")
  
  # Fälle knapp über der Schwelle
  cat("\nCases JUST ABOVE the threshold:\n")
  print(
    df_gesamt %>%
      filter(pop_max > grenzwerte[i]) %>%
      arrange(pop_max) %>%
      select(sendung, sentences...20, pop_max) %>%
      head(5)
  )
  
  # Fälle knapp unter der Schwelle
  cat("\nCases JUST BELOW the threshold:\n")
  print(
    df_gesamt %>%
      filter(pop_max <= grenzwerte[i]) %>%
      arrange(desc(pop_max)) %>%
      select(sendung, sentences...20, pop_max) %>%
      head(5)
  )
}
```

# 95th percentile

## Edge cases 95th percentile
```{r}
# 95. Perzentil-Schwelle berechnen
schwelle_95 <- quantile(df_gesamt$pop_max, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

# Anzahl der Sätze über der Schwelle (d.h. populistisch nach deiner Definition)
anzahl_95 <- sum(df_gesamt$pop_max > schwelle_95, na.rm = TRUE)

# Prozentualer Anteil dieser Sätze
anteil_95 <- mean(df_gesamt$pop_max > schwelle_95, na.rm = TRUE) * 100

## Number of sentences above the 95% threshold: 4,256 
## Percentage share: 4.999941 %

# per broadcast:
df_gesamt %>%
  group_by(sendung) %>%
  summarise(
    n_gesamt = n(),
    n_populistisch = sum(pop_max > schwelle_95, na.rm = TRUE),
    anteil_populistisch = mean(pop_max > schwelle_95, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(anteil_populistisch))


# Top 5 above threshold
 top5_ueber <- df_gesamt %>%
   filter(pop_max > schwelle_95) %>%
   arrange(pop_max) %>%
   slice_head(n = 5) %>%
   mutate(grenztyp = "über")

# Top 5 below threshold
 top5_unter <- df_gesamt %>%
   filter(pop_max <= schwelle_95) %>%
   arrange(desc(pop_max)) %>%
   slice_head(n = 5) %>%
   mutate(grenztyp = "unter")

# Combine into one table
 top5_tab <- bind_rows(top5_ueber, top5_unter) %>%
   select(grenztyp, sendung, sentences...20, pop_max)

```

### Table of edge cases 95th percentile
```{r}
last_ueber <- max(which(top5_tab$grenztyp == "über"))

top5_tab_final <- top5_tab %>%
  # Spalten umbenennen und Populismus-Score runden
  mutate(
    Populismus = round(as.numeric(pop_max), 3),
    Grenztyp   = ifelse(grenztyp == "über", "▲ über", "▼ unter"),
    Satz       = sentences...20,
    sendung    = ifelse(sendung == "Haf", "HaF", sendung)
  ) %>%
  # Nur die gewünschten Spalten behalten und Reihenfolge festlegen!
  select(Grenztyp, Satz, Populismus, sendung) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Grenzfälle rund um das 95. Perzentil",
    subtitle = "Top 5 Sätze über und unter der Grenze"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = "Populismus",
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Grenztyp   = "Grenztyp",
    Satz       = "Satz",
    Populismus = "Populismus-Score",
    sendung    = "Sendung"
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(
      sides = "bottom",
      color = "#2d2d2d",
      weight = px(4)
    ),
    locations = cells_body(rows = last_ueber)
  ) %>%
  cols_width(
    Satz ~ px(900)
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 14,
    heading.align = "left",
    data_row.padding = px(7)
  )


# Save as HTML
gtsave(top5_tab_final, "top5_tab_final.html")

# Save HTML as PNG
webshot("top5_tab_final.html", "top5_tab_final.png", zoom = 2)  
```

# Operationalization of Populism (TRUE/FALSE) column
```{r}
df_gesamt <- df_gesamt %>%
  mutate(populismus = pop_max > schwelle_95)
```

# Clean up dataset
```{r}
df_gesamt <- df_gesamt %>%
  relocate(pop_max, populismus, .after = sendung)


# Add populism share as column
df_gesamt <- df_gesamt %>%
  group_by(name, party, job) %>%
  mutate(
    saetze_gesamt = n(),
    saetze_pop = sum(populismus == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    anteil_pop = saetze_pop / saetze_gesamt
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Dataset description

```{r}
df_gesamt <- df_gesamt %>%
  mutate(
    pop_max = pmax(Anti_Elitism, People_Centrism, na.rm = TRUE),
    anti_elite_is_max = Anti_Elitism == pop_max,
    people_centrism_is_max = People_Centrism == pop_max
  )

  sum(df_gesamt$populismus == 1 & df_gesamt$anti_elite_is_max, na.rm = TRUE) # 3629
  sum(df_gesamt$populismus == 1 & df_gesamt$people_centrism_is_max, na.rm = TRUE) #627
```

# Validation of populism classification


```{r}
set.seed(146)

validität <- df_gesamt %>%
  filter(populismus == TRUE) %>%  
  sample_n(380) %>%
  select(sentences...20)             

write.csv(validität, "validität.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
